diagnostics.micChunks.help: Audio chunks captured from your microphone before any silence filtering.
diagnostics.silenceFiltered.help: Microphone chunks deliberately skipped so the server does not receive unnecessary silence.
diagnostics.audioSent.help: Microphone audio chunks successfully queued for WebSocket transmission. This does not guarantee delivery.
diagnostics.audioReceived.help: Audio chunks received from the WebSocket server, before optional playback.
diagnostics.audioDropped.help: Microphone chunks that were rejected because the WebSocket was unavailable or its outgoing buffer was full.
diagnostics.playbackQueued.help: Received audio chunks successfully scheduled for playback; not necessarily already heard.
diagnostics.playbackDropped.explain: Explain Audio not queued for playback
diagnostics.playbackDropped.help: Received audio chunks the player could not schedule. Audio intentionally cleared during interruption is not counted here.
diagnostics.aiSilent.help: Received AI audio chunks containing only zero samples, which may represent silence.
diagnostics.interruptions.help: Times Callio's speech was interrupted so it could listen to the caller.
call.mode.echoHelp: Test microphone streaming without an API key. Playback can be enabled in Advanced.

backend.unavailableHint: Backend unavailable. Start Go with 'go run ./cmd/callio', then select Retry.
backend.liveMissingKey: Gemini Live is not configured. Add GEMINI_API_KEY to .env, restart Go, or select Echo.
